exact_prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
exact_prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

eligibility_probe.pass_rule: For each direction, at least two registered seed indices must produce bitwise-distinct raw policy samples while exact repeats at the same index remain bitwise identical.
eligibility_probe.failure_rule: If the runtime has no exposed seed input, ignores it, or fails exact-repeat stability, pi0.5 is ineligible; do not manufacture repeated behavioral rollouts.

post_probe_boundary.if_eligible: Generate and hash a separate Phase-D behavioral cell registry using the already frozen sixteen shared Phase-D sampling-seed indices before any rollout.
post_probe_boundary.if_ineligible: Publish the ineligibility result with zero stochastic behavioral cells.

fixed observation captured model-blind after a fresh reset
